Name: Mind Numbing Annoyance
Author: ArcticThief
Description:
A quick and simple mod that will make a dialogue box appear randomly as you play the game and interrupt what you're doing. Overall the goal is just for the dialogue box to annoyingly pop up randomly as you play.

The chance is based off of a random number generator that will trigger the dialogue box when the random number is divisible by a certain percentage.

I haven't figured out how to make a config file so you can change the chance the dialogue box appears yet but that is my next goal. At the moment the random number generator picks a number between 1 and 10000 and checks to see if it can be evenly divided by 50. If it can be, the dialogue box appears.

The random number changes every time you press a button or click the mouse.

As far as I'm aware, you should need SMAPI installed for this mod to work properly.

Any advice or feedback is welcome! This is my first mod and a lot of the base code used the initial mod creation tutorial code from the wiki. I'm super inexperienced in mod development but I hope this mod does exactly what you wanted it to.
